description: Photo collage meme depicting Obama-era political and intelligence figures composited behind prison bars, implying they should face treason trials. Recognizable faces include Robert Mueller, John Podesta, Rod Rosenstein, Hillary Clinton, Huma Abedin, James Clapper, John Brennan, Barack Obama, Bill Clinton, and Loretta Lynch. The headline claims Russia collusion is a 'proven lie' and asks when treason trials begin — a claim, not an established fact.
text: NOW THAT RUSSIA COLLUSION IS A PROVEN LIE, WHEN DO THE TRIALS FOR TREASON BEGIN?
flags: Meme asserts 'Russia collusion is a proven lie' — an unverified political claim
Several background figures not identified with certainty

description: Digital graphic of Earth seen from space with a sunrise flare cresting the horizon and a starfield background. Large glowing blue text reads 'IN IT TOGETHER' above the hashtag #WWG1WGA, the QAnon slogan abbreviation for 'Where We Go One We Go All'. Promotional/motivational imagery for the Q movement rather than a photograph of any specific event.
terms: Where We Go One We Go All

description: Composite image pairing a screenshot of Q drop #4772 (9/25/2020) with a Gary Varvel editorial cartoon. The cartoon shows Nancy Pelosi from behind wearing a quiver labeled 'PELOSI QUIVER' holding arrows fletched 'IM-PEACH', 'RIOTS', 'LOOTING' and 'MOBS', referencing her 'arrows in our quiver' remark quoted at the bottom. The Q drop text plays on that quote against a LOSBR (line-of-sight beam riding) missile metaphor.

description: Screenshot of a verified tweet from former CIA Director John O. Brennan (@JohnBrennan), May 7 2018, urging senators to confirm Gina Haspel as CIA Director on her qualifications and not penalize her for past policy decisions or because 'DT' (Donald Trump) picked her.
text: John O. Brennan. @JohnBrennan. Senators: Show that you put country above politics. Gina Haspel is a competent, experienced, & highly qualified intelligence professional. Ask her tough questions, listen to her answers, & then decide but don't penalize her for previous policy decisions or because DT picked her. 7:07 PM · May 7, 2018 · Twitter for iPhone. 1.3K Retweets. 493 Quote Tweets. 6.7K Likes.
